items.question: Has the team described the IT environment of the client, including the systems used for accounting, payroll, stock, invoicing and banking, including mobile money and online banking?
Has the team recorded who looks after the systems, whether in-house or outsourced, and who can change data or settings?
Is access to the accounting system controlled (individual logins, passwords, removal of leavers), and is that appropriate for the size of the client?
Are data backups taken and tested, and is the recovery process known?
Were there significant system changes, migrations or failures during the year, and how did they affect the records?
Does the team plan to rely on system reports or spreadsheets, and has the completeness and accuracy of those reports been tested?
Has the team concluded whether IT weaknesses change the audit approach, and recorded any points for the management letter?
